metadata.title: Short-duration lensing events: I. wide-orbit planets? free-floating low-mass objects? or high-velocity stars?

notes: No eligible stars. The paper is a general theoretical study of short-duration microlensing by hypothetical low-mass or high-velocity lenses; it does not select or analyze any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate. The discussion of unbound hypervelocity stars at T:p2-b2 is a background literature example, not a follow-up study of a named star, and the paper also notes a bound hypervelocity component. The other cited objects are lensing or planet-hosting examples rather than Galactic unbound candidates (T:p8-b0, T:p12-b1).
